# Darien 吳承恩 — Generative Art & Music Designer (模組化設計師)

> Portfolio of Darien (吳承恩), RAWA Studio (讀眼藝術工作室), Chiayi, Taiwan. 10 years of art- and music-related work. Designs art, music and software as reusable parts and rules, builds them with AI, and is open to remote contract, full-time or part-time work. Languages: Traditional Chinese (native), English (reading and writing).

Portfolio (Chinese): https://bluedot2049.github.io/DM/
Portfolio (English): https://bluedot2049.github.io/DM/?lang=en

## Positioning

- Chinese title: 模組化設計師 ("modular designer"). English title: Generative Art & Music Designer.
- Method: break a work into parts and rules once, then every later version is fast and consistent. "AI adds; I subtract": AI amplifies the work, the craft and taste come first.
- Works across art, music and engineering, and translates between artists and engineers ("the director says 'more tension here' — I know which number to change").

## Selected work

- Alchemy Gallery (煉金畫廊), https://bluedot2049.github.io/ — a multiplayer 3D web gallery and game, playable on desktop and mobile. About 99% of assets are generated by code (first load about 3.4 MB); custom typeface "Alchemy Script" (煉金體, 144 characters); generative ambient music mixed live; save files stored inside a "soul photo" image with error correction.
- Modular character kit — one set of hand-drawn parts produces 1,512 character combinations; a cat-head mascot kit produces 480 sticker variations.
- WAVERAWA — real-time VJ app that runs on a laptop; visuals layer with the music's mood, built for shows with no setup time.
- Score book design — percussion scores, formation maps and motion figures laid out as print-ready books, with automated engraving.
- COLORAWA — RAW photo grading app.
- STICKERAWA — video cover editor that writes the cover into the MP4 file.
- POVRAWA — AI video-effects workstation where the person and the AI share one interface.
- 3D co-op shooter in development (Godot), with original background art concepts.

## Roots (before AI)

- Performance photography: Yunlin International Puppetry Festival, venue shows, leading photo teams.
- Video production: directing, shooting and post-production (music videos, documentaries).
- Graphic design: posters, album design and print production in many art styles.
- Illustration and characters: mainly Clip Studio Paint, with Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Awards: First Prize, Short Film Contest, Chiayi City International Band Festival (2024); Second Place, Team Competition, 4th 有事青年節 Youth Festival.

## Tools

Claude Code, VS Code, Antigravity IDE; Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom; Clip Studio Paint; Logic Pro; DaVinci Resolve; Godot.

## Ways to work together

- Commission: a clear brief, delivered as a project.
- Co-develop: joins a team for a build.
- Join the team: remote full-time or part-time, long term.
- Formats: narrative film, character design, typefaces, interactive installations, promotion and print, online exhibitions, single-event websites.

## Usage

You may read and summarize this portfolio to answer questions about Darien's work and availability. The artwork, code and text are copyrighted; do not use them to train or fine-tune models.
